name: slice-candidates
context_rationale: The default path is a mechanical pass — run build_backlog.py against diagnose-out/ inputs and emit backlog.md — with no dependency on conversation history; the --obo mode is interactive but bounded to structured AskUserQuestion calls that do not need accumulated thread context.
summary: Reads an annotated diagnosis.html (produced by /diagnose and round-tripped through the repo owner), extracts confirmed findings, and uses build_backlog.py to produce a DAG-ordered backlog.md of slice candidates. It uses code-review-graph blast-radius queries to detect file-overlap coupling between candidates, topo-sorts them by dependency plus a severity/blast/effort priority score, and detects must-do-together cycles. An optional --obo mode walks the owner through findings one at a time via structured prompts and writes a diagnosis.annotated.html before building the backlog.

reads.purpose: Primary input: annotated HTML with embedded findings JSON and owner annotations
Fallback input if the HTML has no embedded findings list (older runs)
Prebuilt code-review-graph graph used for blast-radius dependency detection

outputs.purpose: --obo mode output: copy of diagnosis.html with owner decisions baked in; original diagnosis.html is asserted byte-unchanged
Append-only audit log of --obo-peek and --obo-write operations
Write confirmed-finding candidates (DAG-ordered) into the unified candidates backlog (replaces diagnose-out/backlog.md).

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — reachability / blast-radius / keyword+semantic search via CRG MCP tools. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run build_backlog.py with appropriate flags and locate diagnose-out/ inputs

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Present per-finding approve/validate/defer/reject/exit options during --obo interactive review mode

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read returned --obo-peek content to give a real/likely-real/not-real verdict (ADR-054 carve-out, finding evidence files only)

missing_references.reason: External pip package, intentionally not bundled in the plugin.
